# Crate `lune_ui_core`

[API reference](../INDEX.md)

App-agnostic glass UI toolkit, core: an immediate-mode painter, the display list it builds, widgets,
the theme, and the seam types (text, input, backdrop material) that adapter crates implement.
Styled after the house look (Fluent/Avalonia; see `docs/glass-styling.md`).

This crate has no dependencies: no wgpu, winit or cosmic-text types appear in its signatures. The
renderer (`lune-ui-wgpu`), the window and input adapter (`lune-ui-winit`) and the OS material
(`lune-ui-platform`) depend on it, and the `lune-ui` facade re-exports all of them.

lune-ui knows nothing about the app that uses it. The app owns the winit event loop and passes
in everything else: fonts, the [`theme::Theme`](theme.md#struct.Theme), hit values (the painter and widgets are
generic over the app's hit type), sizes, scale and time. The crate reads neither the clock nor
the environment, so frames are deterministic.

Modules:
- `color`, `theme` (the `Theme` tokens and the dark preset with its glass layers), `acrylic`
  (Avalonia acrylic colour math);
- `image` (the `ImageStore` seam and image fit geometry),
  `paint` (the `Painter`), `scene` (the display list it builds: plain data and the draw-order
  contract), `text` (specs and the `TextSystem` seam), `icon`, `widgets` (controls, menus,
  dropdowns, dialogs), `chrome` (tab outline geometry);
- `text_edit` (the pure editing engine: caret, selection, undo, clipboard commands, preedit);
- `input` (the input seam: `RawInput` in, `FrameOutput` out, plain data), `layout` (pure stack,
  row, column and grid helpers);
- `json` (the bounded JSON reader behind theme and locale files);
- `shortcuts` (the scoped key-chord registry the frame resolves in two phases);
- `drag` (in-window drag and drop: the pure reorder and free machines and their `Ui` glue);
- `ui` (the per-window frame: ids, retained state, layered hits, overlays, focus, semantic
  nodes, `Response`, `FrameOutput`), `access` (the semantic tree and accessibility actions),
  `motion` (the closed-form motion system and the time type), `strings` (the string table);
- `backdrop` (the material seam: `GlassLayer`, `LuminosityCurve`, `BackdropKind`, `Material` and the `Backdrop`
  capability);
- `window` (edge resize, double click, caption buttons);
- `desktop` (desktop units, monitors, popup placement and window shapes) and `dock` (docking,
  snapping and the group drag, in those units);
- `tray` (the tray icon rasterised on the CPU, where its flyout and menu go, the click rules);
- `testing` (fakes of the seams for tests: the display-list recorder, a fake text system
  and its contract suite, a scripted input source, a null material and its contract suite).

Values in the dark preset are copied from the house look's `DarkTheme.axaml` and `App.axaml`, so
apps styled after it match.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/lib.rs:1`

## Modules

- [`access`](access.md) - Accessibility data: the semantic tree a frame returns, its node fields, and the actions an assistive technology sends back.
- [`acrylic`](acrylic.md) - Avalonia `ExperimentalAcrylicMaterial` colour math, ported so the glass layers produce the same pixels as the Avalonia look.
- [`backdrop`](backdrop.md) - The material seam: the OS backdrop behind a transparent window.
- [`chrome`](chrome.md) - Tab chrome loop: one closed outline that wraps the active tab and the card body.
- [`code_doc`](code_doc.md) - The document of the code editor: one `String` and a line index (D179).
- [`color`](color.md) - Colour type and helpers shared by the toolkit and its apps.
- [`desktop`](desktop.md) - The desktop in one coordinate space: points and rects in desktop units, monitors, popup placement in that space, and window shapes.
- [`dock`](dock.md) - Docking maths for windows in desktop units: which rects touch, the sets they form, how a moving set snaps to screen areas and to other windows, and the drag that keeps a set together.
- [`drag`](drag.md) - In-window drag and drop (`infra.drag-and-drop`): pointer tracking only, never the OS drag API.
- [`icon`](icon.md) - Codicons, as mapped into the Nerd Font (the house look uses the Codicons icon pack).
- [`image`](image.md) - Images: the plain data an app registers once under an [`ImageId`](image.md#struct.ImageId), the [`ImageStore`](image.md#trait.ImageStore) seam a renderer implements to hold the pixels, and the pure fi...
- [`input`](input.md) - The input seam: what the app hands the toolkit each frame ([`RawInput`](input.md#struct.RawInput)) and what the toolkit hands back ([`FrameOutput`](input.md#struct.FrameOutput)).
- [`json`](json.md) - A bounded JSON reader.
- [`layout`](layout.md) - Pure layout helpers: a parent rect and child sizes in, child rects out.
- [`motion`](motion.md) - Motion: the closed-form animation model (`docs/motion.md`).
- [`paint`](paint.md) - Immediate-mode painter: every frame the UI is described from state into per-layer geometry, text placements and hit regions.
- [`scene`](scene.md) - The display list: plain data the [`Painter`](paint.md#struct.Painter) builds for one frame and a renderer consumes.
- [`shortcuts`](shortcuts.md) - The shortcut registry: scoped key chords mapped to command ids.
- [`strings`](strings.md) - The string table: the app's and the toolkit's translated strings, looked up by key with `{n}` and `{n:spec}` placeholders.
- [`testing`](testing.md) - Fakes of the toolkit's seams, for tests in this crate and in apps.
- [`text`](text.md) - Text: what to draw ([`Spec`](text.md#struct.Spec) runs of [`Style`](text.md#struct.Style)d text) and the [`TextSystem`](text.md#trait.TextSystem) seam that shapes it.
- [`text_edit`](text_edit.md) - The text editing engine: caret, selection, navigation, undo and redo, clipboard commands and the preedit an input method composes.
- [`theme`](theme.md) - UI tokens read by the toolkit's widgets, and the Lunegit dark preset.
- [`tray`](tray.md) - The tray's pure logic (`platform.tray-icon`, M10): the icon rasterised on the CPU, where the flyout and the menu go from the icon's rect, and the click rules that open and close them.
- [`ui`](ui.md) - The per-window `Ui` frame: stable widget ids under scopes, a retained store with transient and keep-alive state, layered hit testing with pointer capture, [`Response`](ui.md#struct.Response), animated...
- [`widgets`](widgets.md) - Controls, styled after the house look's overrides of the Fluent theme (`DarkTheme.axaml`).
- [`window`](window.md) - Helpers for a borderless glass window: edge resizing, title-bar double click and Windows 11 style caption buttons.
